translation: Sweet in flavor, slightly cold, non-toxic. It treats stomach bi (胃痹), heat-in-the-center (熱中), wasting-thirst (消渴), stopping diarrhea and dysentery (止泄痢), benefiting urination (利小便), boosting qi (益氣), supplementing the center (補中), and lightening the body and [lengthening] the years (輕身[延]年).
